# anyonce

> Transport-agnostic idempotent execution for serverless and edge systems: one core state machine behind three doors (HTTP `Idempotency-Key`, anyq queue consumers, Standard Webhooks `webhook-id` receivers), six atomic stores, TypeScript and Go, and a conformance suite for the IETF Idempotency-Key draft.

Semantics: every operation is identified by (scope, key) and carries a fingerprint of its payload. `begin` claims the key in one atomic write on every store (no get-then-lock) and returns acquired, in_flight, completed or mismatch. An acquired claim holds a lease and a monotonic fence token; a claim whose lease expired is re-acquirable with fence + 1, and `complete` or `abandon` with a stale fence is rejected. A completed record is replayed to duplicates with `Idempotency-Replayed: true`. A duplicate while the claim is live is 409 `conflict` with `Retry-After` (lease remaining, seconds); the same key with a different fingerprint is 422 `fingerprint-mismatch`; a missing key when required is 400 `missing-key`. Storage rule (D6): results with status below 500 are stored and replayed; a 5xx or a thrown error abandons the record so the client can retry. Stored bodies over `maxResultBytes` (1 MiB default) complete in an omitted form that replays status and headers with `Idempotency-Replay: omitted`. Records expire after a TTL (24 h default), enforced on read and by `purge(now)`. Errors are RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code`. Queue door: a completed duplicate is acknowledged without running the handler, an in-flight duplicate parks for the lease remainder, a mismatch dead-letters with reason `fingerprint-mismatch`, through the companion strategy. Webhook door: signature verification always runs before the store is touched.

## Packages

- `@anyonce/core`: engine, types, key helpers, fingerprints and the in-process store. exports: execute, defaultPolicy, defaultStoreResult, MemoryStore, newKey, redactKey, parseKey, validateKey, httpFingerprint, jcsFingerprint, sha256Hex, canonicalize, parseSfString, DEFAULT_LEASE_MS, DEFAULT_TTL_MS, DEFAULT_MAX_RESULT_BYTES, MAX_KEY_BYTES
- `@anyonce/core/http`: `withIdempotency` for any fetch handler plus the shared HTTP helpers. exports: withIdempotency, idempotencyOf, runIdempotent, withProtocolHeaders, problem, problemResponse, lookupKey, captureResponse, replayResponse, DEFAULT_HEADER_NAME, DEFAULT_METHODS, DEFAULT_PROBLEM_BASE_URI, PROBLEM_STATUS
- `@anyonce/core/testing`: the shared store contract suite, for a store of your own. exports: storeContractSuite, T0, LEASE_MS, TTL_MS, MAX_RESULT_BYTES
- `@anyonce/hono`: Hono middleware for the HTTP door. exports: idempotency, withIdempotency, idempotencyOf
- `@anyonce/anyq`: anyq consumer middleware and the companion strategy (both required). exports: idempotent, idempotencyStrategy, InFlightError, FingerprintMismatchError, FingerprintError, isInFlightError, isFingerprintMismatchError, messageFingerprint, DEFAULT_KEY_HEADER, IDEMPOTENCY_STRATEGY_NAME
- `@anyonce/webhooks`: Standard Webhooks receiver, verification before deduplication. exports: webhookReceiver, standardWebhooksVerify, markVerified, isVerified, parseSecret, DEFAULT_ID_HEADER, DEFAULT_TOLERANCE_SECONDS
- `@anyonce/stores`: the record codec shared by the stores. exports: newRow, rowToRecord, encodeResultMeta, decodeResultMeta, bytesToBase64, base64ToBytes
- `@anyonce/stores/durable-objects`: Cloudflare Durable Objects store, one object per scope. exports: DurableObjectsStore, IdempotencyObject
- `@anyonce/stores/d1`: Cloudflare D1 store. exports: D1Store, ensureSchema, MIGRATION_SQL
- `@anyonce/stores/dynamodb`: DynamoDB store, one conditional UpdateItem per claim. exports: DynamoDbStore, ensureTable, itemKey, DYNAMODB_MAX_RESULT_BYTES
- `@anyonce/stores/redis`: Redis store, one Lua script per transition (ioredis, node-redis, Upstash). exports: RedisStore, fromIoredis, fromNodeRedis, fromUpstash
- `@anyonce/stores/postgres`: Postgres store (postgres.js, Neon). exports: PostgresStore, fromPostgresJs, fromNeon, ensureSchema, MIGRATION_SQL
- `@anyonce/conformance`: conformance runner and the `anyonce-conformance` CLI. exports: runConformance, loadVectors, runVector, runVectors, evaluateExpect, formatReport, toSender
- `@anyonce/conformance/runtime`: the runner without the file loader and the CLI, for workerd. exports: runConformance, runVector, runVectors, evaluateExpect, formatReport, toSender

`@anyonce/stores/migrations/*` ships the Postgres and D1 SQL migrations as files.

## Go

Module `github.com/sns45/anyonce/go`, Go 1.26, no cgo.

- `github.com/sns45/anyonce/go/anyonce`: engine, Store interface, keys, fingerprints, sentinel errors. exports: Execute, Store, Policy, DefaultPolicy, Record, Operation, NewKey, RedactKey, ParseKey, ValidateKey, HTTPFingerprint, JCSFingerprint, ErrConflict, ErrMismatch, ErrStaleFence, ErrStoreUnavailable
- `github.com/sns45/anyonce/go/httpmw`: net/http middleware for the HTTP door. exports: New, Middleware, Options, KeyFromContext, FenceFromContext, NewProblem, WriteProblem, DefaultMethods
- `github.com/sns45/anyonce/go/anyqmw`: anyq consumer middleware and the companion strategy (both required). exports: Wrap, Strategy, Options, KeySourceID, KeySourceHeader, KeySourceBody, InFlightRetry, InFlightAck, InFlightError, ErrFingerprintMismatch, DefaultKeyHeader
- `github.com/sns45/anyonce/go/webhookmw`: webhook receiver middleware, verification before deduplication. exports: New, Middleware, Options, MarkVerified, IsVerified, DefaultIDHeader
- `github.com/sns45/anyonce/go/standardwebhooks`: Standard Webhooks signature verification. exports: New, Verifier, ParseSecret, ErrVerification, DefaultTolerance
- `github.com/sns45/anyonce/go/store/memory`: in-process store. exports: New, Store
- `github.com/sns45/anyonce/go/store/dynamodb`: DynamoDB store. exports: New, Options, Store, EnsureTable, MaxResultBytes
- `github.com/sns45/anyonce/go/store/redis`: Redis store. exports: New, Options, Store
- `github.com/sns45/anyonce/go/store/postgres`: Postgres store on database/sql. exports: New, Open, Options, EnsureSchema, Schema
- `github.com/sns45/anyonce/go/store/sqlite`: SQLite store on modernc.org/sqlite. exports: New, Open, EnsureSchema, Schema
- `github.com/sns45/anyonce/go/storetest`: the store contract suite. exports: Run, Harness, Factory
- `github.com/sns45/anyonce/go/conformance`: Go conformance runner. exports: Run, RunVectors, LoadVectors, Options, Summary

## Examples

- [worker-hono-do](https://github.com/sns45/anyonce/tree/main/examples/worker-hono-do): Cloudflare Worker, Hono, Durable Objects store
- [lambda-fetch-dynamodb](https://github.com/sns45/anyonce/tree/main/examples/lambda-fetch-dynamodb): AWS Lambda function URL, withIdempotency, DynamoDB store
- [go-net-http-postgres](https://github.com/sns45/anyonce/tree/main/examples/go-net-http-postgres): Go net/http, httpmw, Postgres store
- [anyq-consumer-ts](https://github.com/sns45/anyonce/tree/main/examples/anyq-consumer-ts): anyq consumer in TypeScript with idempotent and idempotencyStrategy
- [anyq-consumer-go](https://github.com/sns45/anyonce/tree/main/examples/anyq-consumer-go): anyq consumer in Go with anyqmw.Wrap and anyqmw.Strategy
- [webhook-receiver-standard-webhooks](https://github.com/sns45/anyonce/tree/main/examples/webhook-receiver-standard-webhooks): Standard Webhooks receiver
